text: Declaration These database (s) can be shared to academic institutions only for carrying out the research for academic purpose. For receiving the database one should send a letter through proper channel (through Head of the de pt/institution) stating the purpose of the requested database. Along with the letter, also enclose the declaration (agreeing to the terms and conditions mentioned below) signed by you and forwarded by Head of the dept./institution. The declaration should contain the following statements: 1. The database should be used for academic research and development purpose only. 2. The dababase or it's derivatives should not be used for any commercial benefits. 3. The user should not redistribute the database. 4. IIT Kharagpur will not be responsible for any harm caused by using this database. 5. The users should quote the relevant publications of this Database in their articles. Contact Details: K.
